about: F35 design (i)'s shared cases, written from snapshotValues by fabric/app/src/data/kept-value-cases.test.ts: don't edit. Times are seconds after base. A case's series are target, analysis, metric; its saves are capture, window start, window end; a row is a series' index, a bin, a save's index, and a value; a bin is a series' index, a bin, and the rule's value.

cases.name: a session's minutes and a day save's 15-minute totals: the day keeps only what the session doesn't hold
a peak after the session's window: the day save's lag from 16:57 to 17:00 stays
a stop save whose last minutes have no rows: the later day save keeps them
partly arrived rows in a stop save's last bins: short by what hadn't arrived, at most one 15-minute bin
three grains: a 1-minute session, a 5-minute stop save, and a 15-minute day save
a peak lower than the finer points it overlaps is dropped
a peak higher than the finer points it overlaps stays
Azure Monitor: a day save of a T4 that ran a few hours keeps its 5-minute step
an hourly metric: the newer save of the same hour wins
off the bin grid: the newest capture
the same grain: the newer save wins where they overlap
a total over two files of one save: what's left is split by their values
nothing finer: every row keeps its value
a binned row without a value counts as 0, and a row with no bin is the newest capture's
